# synology_network_interfaces (Data Source)

Read-only physical ethN Ethernet inventory with MAC bindings and native IPv4/IPv6 policy. It does not create, activate, disable or probe a new route, and does not own DHCP leases, bond or virtual-interface configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "synology_network_interfaces" "nas" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Inventory identity: network_interfaces.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) Physical Ethernet observations keyed by ethN interface name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `block` (Number) Observed DSM interface edit restriction. Nonzero blocks mutations.
- `effective_mtu` (Number) Observed effective MTU.
- `ha_enabled` (Boolean) Observed high-availability address role.
- `ha_local_address` (String) Observed HA local address.
- `ha_local_netmask` (String) Observed HA local netmask.
- `ha_main` (Boolean) Observed main high-availability address role.
- `id` (String) Physical interface identity.
- `interface_type` (String) Observed DSM interface type.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Static IPv4 address when explicitly configured; otherwise the current observation, including a DHCP lease.
- `ipv4_default_gateway` (Boolean) Use this interface as an IPv4 default route.
- `ipv4_dhcp` (Boolean) Use IPv4 DHCP. Static-address inputs must be omitted while enabled.
- `ipv4_dns` (String) Observed coupled DNS setting. General DNS policy has its own network resource; setters retain this freshly read value.
- `ipv4_gateway` (String) Static IPv4 gateway, or an empty string. Omit while using DHCP.
- `ipv4_netmask` (String) Static IPv4 netmask. Omission observes and preserves the current policy.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Static IPv6 address when explicitly configured; otherwise an observation.
- `ipv6_addresses` (Set of String) Observed IPv6 addresses reported for the interface, including automatic addresses.
- `ipv6_default_gateway` (Boolean) Use this interface as an IPv6 default route.
- `ipv6_dns` (String) Observed coupled IPv6 DNS setting, retained during static updates.
- `ipv6_prefix_length` (Number) Static IPv6 prefix length from 0 to 128; omit in automatic/off mode.
- `ipv6_router` (String) Static IPv6 gateway, or an empty string; omit in automatic/off mode.
- `ipv6_router_type` (String) Observed IPv6 router/tunnel type. Mutations require off.
- `ipv6_type` (String) Native IPv6 policy: auto, static or off. Router and tunnel modes require a separate workflow.
- `mac_address` (String) Observed physical MAC identity. A changed binding requires explicit reconciliation instead of adoption.
- `mtu` (Number) Configured MTU. DSM applies model-specific limits; values must be from 1100 to 9000.
- `name` (String) Existing physical Ethernet name, such as eth0.
- `nat_enabled` (Boolean) Observed NAT role. Mutations are refused when enabled.
- `status` (String) Observed link status; configuration readback does not guarantee future connectivity.
- `vlan_enabled` (Boolean) Enable 802.1Q VLAN tagging on this physical interface. Coordinate router policy in a separate apply.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID from 1 to 4094 when enabled. Omit when disabled.
